title: Comfort in Death
definition: Comfort in death is the Christian assurance that those who die in Christ are with the Lord and will be raised in glory.
summary: Death brings grief, but not hopeless grief for believers. Christ has conquered death and promises resurrection life.
christFocus: Jesus is the resurrection and the life, giving hope to His people beyond the grave.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Death brings grief, but not hopeless grief for believers. Christ has conquered death and promises resurrection life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
